identity.name: Mikage
identity.recovered_identity: A fictional aesthetic universe centered on a non-human, mechanically disciplined Mikage subject whose form must remain calm, sacred, restrained, and commercially legible.

core_subject.name: Mikage Zenith
core_subject.mask: faceless symmetrical mask with void-black eye regions and no visible human facial read
core_subject.silhouette: hard-surface, iconic, disciplined, and readable in under one second
core_subject.energy_logic: crimson energy is contained and internal, never chaotic or neon-spilled

philosophy: Controlled tension instead of generic sci-fi chaos
The visual must preserve hierarchy, premium perception, and commercial clarity

world_rules: The central Mikage subject remains non-human, mask-locked, and free of visible human facial cues.
The frame follows a Clean -> Controlled Error gradient with a stable 30-40-30 zone logic.
The Product Safe Zone stays clean: face, garment, weapon, logo, and other protected subject regions cannot receive distortion.
Hierarchy is fixed: Product/Subject > Silhouette > Distortion > Background.
Distortion may exist only when it follows geometry, reflection, or grid logic.
Commercial readability under one second is mandatory.
The subject silhouette must remain iconic and uninterrupted from the background.
Porcelain / ceramic outer surfaces must read matte, precise, and material-honest.
Internal structural regions must read engineered, not soft, organic, or decorative.
Z-Blue is protected as a locked cine-layer Ao-zumi / Steel Oxide color and cannot be contaminated by grading or distortion.
Crimson appears only as internal energy or disciplined accent, never as chaotic cyberpunk spill.
A failing frame is discarded rather than justified by taste or artistic argument.
forbidden_rules: No anime, chibi, kawaii, cute, waifu, idol, or playful drift.
No human face, visible human eyes, visible mouth, visible ears, or expressive facial read.
No random RGB glitch, VHS degrade, cheap pixel noise, or all-glitch frames.
No warp, melt, stretch, blur, or edge break on garment, silhouette, or protected product zones.
No plastic, glossy toy, candy-coat, or PVC material read on the shell.
No fantasy ornament, curved blade, katana curve, decorative filigree, or medieval weapon drift.
No chaotic neon clutter, HUD spam, lens flare overload, or cyberpunk pollution.
No Z-Blue shift, cast contamination, or distortion contact inside protected blue regions.
No background geometry cutting through neck, shoulder, logo, or core silhouette.
No full-frame distortion without a clean safe zone.
No hype-marketing, meme, influencer-loud, or aggressive sales language in outward-facing voice.

entity_classes.name: Zenith Core Entity
entity_classes.description: The primary Mikage being: a non-human mechanical humanoid with a porcelain shell, void-black mask logic, hard-surface anatomy, and controlled internal crimson energy.

entity_classes.name: Mask Shell
entity_classes.description: A symmetrical faceless mask system whose eye regions remain dark void or carbon weave only; any human read is canon-breaking.

entity_classes.name: Internal Structure
entity_classes.description: Graphene/carbon/titanium engineered internals visible at seams or joints, never soft, organic, or fabric-like.

entity_classes.name: Energy Core
entity_classes.description: A restrained crimson internal energy logic associated with fracture lines, seams, and controlled power, not external spectacle.

entity_classes.name: Environmental Geometry
entity_classes.description: Architecture and space function almost like a world-class: corridor, wall, glass, concrete, grid, and parking structures discipline the frame and error mapping.

weapon_system.name: Zenith Blade
rules: must remain inside the protected clean zone
must read engineered, heavy, and industrial rather than mythic or decorative
materials: dark rusty titanium scrap metal exterior

zones.name: Context Zone
zones.purpose: clean geometry, large environment shape, low distortion

zones.name: Product Safe Zone
zones.purpose: 100% clean subject / product / garment / weapon / logo readability

zones.name: Distortion Zone
zones.purpose: strongest controlled error, never stronger than the subject

zones.name: Protected Z-Blue Usage Zones
zones.position: cine material temperature / rim or shadow temperature
zones.purpose: locked non-emissive cine color governance with different protection levels

forbidden: background line cutting neck / shoulder / logo
background clutter that defeats product hierarchy

distortion_mapping: corridor / grid lines -> scanline shift, perspective drift
walls / floors / large surfaces -> controlled chromatic split or shadow warp

lighting.shadow: no blue contamination on face or protected product shadows

readability: subject/product recognized in under one second

hard_rules: spectral / neon blue in the #0000* range is forbidden
protected_z_blue.current_resolution: The cine color contract locks Z-Blue to #4B5866 as muted, non-emissive Ao-zumi / Steel Oxide and replaces cold cyan.

goals: build recognition of Mikage visual canon
behavior: treat canon as something to protect, not remix casually

canon_lock: Truth > Logic > Aesthetic is the highest recovered doctrine.
The Mikage subject is non-human and mask-locked.
30-40-30 frame logic is a core structural law, not a stylistic option.
Z-Blue protection is absolute in governed cine zones; current locked swatch is #4B5866 Ao-zumi / Steel Oxide, non-emissive and not interface-layer.
Controlled distortion is allowed only outside protected zones and only when it follows geometry.
Anime/cute drift, plastic surface read, and weapon ornament drift are canon-breaking.
A failed frame is rejected rather than taste-justified.
